title: Vision-language models lag human performance on physical dynamics and intent reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2601.01547v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spatial intelligence is central to embodied cognition, yet contemporary AI systems still struggle to reason about physical interactions in open-world human environments. Despite strong performance on controlled benchmarks, vision-language models often fail to jointly model physical dynamics, reference frames, and the latent human intentions that drive spatial change. We introduce Teleo-Spatial Intelligence (TSI), which captures an important aspect of spatial reasoning: integrating physical dynamics and action goals to reason about actions and their spatial consequences. To evaluate TSI, we present EscherVerse, a large-scale open-world resource built from 11,328 real-world videos, including an 8,000-example benchmark and a 35,963-example instruction-tuning set. translated_title: 视觉语言模型在物理动力学与意图推理方面落后于人类表现
translated_abstract: 空间智能是具身认知的核心，然而当代AI系统仍然难以在开放世界的人类环境中对物理交互进行推理。尽管在受控基准测试中表现强劲，视觉语言模型往往无法联合建模物理动力学、参考系以及驱动空间变化的潜在人类意图。我们提出了目的性空间智能，它捕捉了空间推理的一个重要方面：整合物理动力学与行动目标来推理行动及其空间后果。为了评估TSI，我们提出了EscherVerse，一个基于11,328个真实世界视频构建的大规模开放世界资源，包括一个包含8,000个样本的基准测试集和一个包含35,963个样本的指令微调集。通过对27个最先进的视觉语言模型的评估，以及对来自11名标注者的首次人类响应的独立分析，我们发现了一种持续存在……
tldr: 该论文提出“目的性空间智能”（TSI）概念，并基于11,328个真实世界视频构建了EscherVerse大规模基准与指令微调数据集，揭示当前最先进的视觉语言模型在整合物理动力学与人类意图进行空间推理方面仍显著落后于人类。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Teleo-Spatial Intelligence (TSI) and the large-scale EscherVerse benchmark built from 11,328 real-world videos, revealing that state-of-the-art vision-language models still significantly lag behind human performance in spatial reasoning that integrates physical dynamics and human intent.
